blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A prosecution witness told the Sandiganbayan on Monday that he personally saw four “maleta” (suitcases) in Co’s office back when he was still a businessman and not yet a member of the House of Representatives. Larry Bellen, who worked as an executive aide of ex-Ako Bicol representative beginning in 2018, made this known when he testified before the anti-graft court during the bail hearing of Romualdez, who faces a plunder case stemming from alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects worth P7.44 billion.
